tool_args.rationale: The eight observations cluster near y = 2.24 u_now, consistent with a largely damped transient at the target horizon. A regularized local linear horizon correction allows residual dependence on initial state and horizon while numerically fitting all coefficients. Fresh confirmation is needed to test whether this local approximation meets tolerance.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Already acquired; the available observations support a compact local-horizon fit.
Their stated uncoupled forms do not directly explain the observed approximately 2.24-fold response to present input.
It is not a discriminating probe for the observed horizon dependence.
